description.p: Abstrakt Deck is a native audio-reactive kaleidoscope visualizer. It captures live audio input and renders GPU-accelerated kaleidoscopic scenes that react to the sound in real time.

ul.li: Real-time audio capture with FFT analysis
GPU rendering with wgpu across multiple 3D shapes and painters
Configurable kaleidoscope folds, zoom, rotation, color harmonies and overlays
MIDI control input and savable presets
